title: Preparing sheet music for rehearsal

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can pick up the choir music before rehearsal. Do we still need twenty copies of the new song?
turns.zh: 我可以在排練前去拿合唱團的歌譜。新曲還需要二十份嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, but the print shop used the version from last month. I emailed a corrected final page this morning. Only the ending changed.
turns.zh: 要，不過影印店印的是上個月的版本。我今天早上有寄更正後的最後一頁。只有結尾有改。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They've already put all twenty copies in folders. If the shop prints the final page again, I can put it in each folder.
turns.zh: 他們已經把二十份都放進資料夾了。如果店家重印最後一頁，我可以把它放進每個資料夾。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Please take the old page out, too. We can't stop rehearsal to explain which ending to sing. I'll tell the group to bring a pencil to mark the places where they come in.
turns.zh: 也請把舊的一頁抽出來。我們不能停下排練來解釋該唱哪個結尾。我會請大家帶鉛筆，標記自己要從哪裡開始唱。

passageZh:
合唱團志工：我可以在排練前去拿合唱團的歌譜。新曲還需要二十份嗎？
合唱指導：要，不過影印店印的是上個月的版本。我今天早上有寄更正後的最後一頁。只有結尾有改。
合唱團志工：他們已經把二十份都放進資料夾了。如果店家重印最後一頁，我可以把它放進每個資料夾。
合唱指導：也請把舊的一頁抽出來。我們不能停下排練來解釋該唱哪個結尾。我會請大家帶鉛筆，標記自己要從哪裡開始唱。
audioScript:
I can pick up the choir music before rehearsal. Do we still need twenty copies of the new song?
Yes, but the print shop used the version from last month. I emailed a corrected final page this morning. Only the ending changed.
They've already put all twenty copies in folders. If the shop prints the final page again, I can put it in each folder.
Please take the old page out, too. We can't stop rehearsal to explain which ending to sing. I'll tell the group to bring a pencil to mark the places where they come in.
